defectsFoundOnDevice.symptom: Pressing back while live recognition is running kills the process with SIGSEGV (null pointer) in libLiteRt.so; reproduced 3/3
defectsFoundOnDevice.cause: VisionPlugin release stops the camera then closes the LiteRT interpreter immediately; cameraExecutor.shutdown() does not wait for the in-flight frame (~550 ms), so Interpreter.run() reads freed native memory
defectsFoundOnDevice.fix: YoloDetector: inference and close are mutually exclusive under a lock; close() during inference only marks closed and the finishing frame releases the interpreter (no main-thread wait)

defectsFoundOnDevice.symptom: After taking a photo in read text, the app crashes with IllegalStateException: Reply already submitted; the recognition result is never shown
defectsFoundOnDevice.cause: On Android onActivityResult starts recognition before Flutter resumes; the upward paused->hidden lifecycle transition was treated as leaving, so Dart sent cancelMenu (cancelRead replied null), then the finished OCR replied again on the captured reply
defectsFoundOnDevice.fix: MenuPlugin replies only if the request is still current (readReply === reply); menu_page treats hidden right after paused as returning and skips the leaving branch (no cancel, pending readout kept)
defectsFoundOnDevice.regressionTest: app/test/menu_ui_test.dart 'Android camera return: recognizing starts before resume and is not cancelled' (fails before the Dart fix, passes after)

deviceRetest.backDuringRecognition: 5 runs; 4 valid (recognition frames logged before back): same pid before/after, 0 crash logs. Run 1 pressed back before recognition started and is not counted
deviceRetest.readTextAfterPhoto: user photo of printed text: no crash, recognition completed, general reading lines shown; same image switched to menu price view (1 category, 11 segments)
deviceRetest.routeRecording: shows '此裝置未支援路標相機' with controls disabled; non-fatal platform_views error for the unregistered native preview view
